events.command: ls -la && echo "---" && cat pricing_cache.py && echo "---GREP lookup---" && grep -rn "lookup\|pricing_cache\|CACHE_TTL" . --include=* -I 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^\./\.git/"
ls -la; echo "---FILES---"; git ls-files; echo "---GREP---"; grep -rn -I -e lookup -e pricing_cache -e CACHE_TTL . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\./\.git/'
git branch -a; git config --get init.defaultBranch; git log --oneline -3

git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h, drop unused snapshot fallback

CACHE_TTL_SECONDS goes from 900 to 3600, so a cached pricing entry is
reused for an hour instead of 15 minutes.

lookup() and its previous-snapshot fallback are removed. It had no
callers anywhere in the repo, so nothing depended on the late-feed
behaviour it provided.
EOF
echo "---"; git log --stat -1; git status --short
